title: Counting Defects: Semilinear Reachability and Resource Bounds for Langton's Ant
description: Effective all-coordinate bounded-defect synthesis with complete endpoint fields; semilinear initial-supply and defect spectra; a finite-collection supply dichotomy; a sharp three-parameter fold-consumer classification; analytic small positive witnesses and unary NP membership. The self-contained artifact replays exact supplied-schema arithmetic and finite-cover reconstruction. A restricted polynomial-size quantifier-free realization backend, shared factor circuits and an FP^NP minimum-cost bound complement the general semilinear compiler.
